blocks.text: Group 2 ki sab dhaatein oxygen mein jal kar metal oxides, MO, banati hain: 2M + O2 -> 2MO. Beryllium sirf ooncha darja hararat (600 C se oopar) par oxygen se react kar ke BeO banata hai, 2Be(s) + O2(g) -> 2BeO(s); patli mazboot oxide ki teh aam taur par ise bachati aur doosron se kam reactive banati hai. Magnesium hawa ya oxygen mein chamak kar jalta aur magnesium oxide banata, aur calcium is se bhi tez eent jaise surkh shole ke saath react karta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar shole (flames) saath saath, Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba likhe hue: magnesium ka shola safaid, calcium ka kinaron par laal aur beech mein peela, strontium ka laal aur barium ka hara.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magnesium tez safaid roshni se jalta hai. Calcium ka shola eent jaisa laal (brick red) hai, jaisa text kehta hai; strontium gehra laal (crimson) aur barium halka hara (apple green) rang deta hai. Inhi rangon ki wajah se yeh dhaatein aatish baazi (fireworks) mein use hoti hain.
Group 2 ke oxides aam taur par safaid thos aur basic hain; un ka basic pan group mein neeche barhta hai. Paani mein oxide ion react kar ke hydroxide ions deta hai: O2-(s) + H2O(l) -> 2OH-(aq).

blocks.title: Basic oxide
blocks.text: Basic oxide paani se react kar ke hydroxide ions (ya tezaabon se namak aur paani) banata hai. Group 2 ke oxides basic oxides hain.
